theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_mil_tendsto_integral_mul_det
theorems.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (A : ℕ → Fin n → Fin n → α → ℝ) (A₀ : Fin n → Fin n → α → ℝ) (h : ℕ → α → ℝ) (h₀ H : α → ℝ), (∀ m t s, AEStronglyMeasurable (A m t s) μ) → (∀ m, AEStronglyMeasurable (h m) μ) → Integrable H μ → (∀ m t s x, |A m t s x| ≤ C) → (∀ᶠ m in atTop, ∀ x, |h m x| ≤ H x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun m => h m x) atTop (𝓝 (h₀ x))) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ t s, Tendsto (fun m => A m t s x) atTop (𝓝 (A₀ t s x))) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, h m x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s => A m t s x) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, h₀ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s => A₀ t s x) ∂μ))
